summary: tighten quotas (10 free, 30 pro) + bump max_tokens to fit full response with citations
description:
Two cost-related issues from operator review:

1. Quotas are too generous to ever be profitable. At Claude Sonnet 4.5 pricing (~$3 in / $15 out per Mtok) and ~2.5K avg tokens/query, 500 pro queries/day = ~$29/month worst case per pro user vs $12 revenue. 30 free queries/day at deepseek pricing isn't catastrophic but invites abuse.

   Drop to free: 10 / pro: 30. Keeps free as a 'try it' tier and bounds pro worst-case to ~$2/day.

   Two LIMITS definitions today (src/app/api/quota/route.ts:11 and src/lib/quota.ts:10) — drift risk. Consolidate to one canonical location and import.

2. Responses are truncating mid-output, sometimes inside the MANDATORY CITATIONS block. completeStream uses max_tokens: 2048; the prompt's structured response format (analysis + citations) routinely needs more. The truncation at /chat/e4f9d4f7-46fe-455a-b97e-c49fcf2a0713 cut off mid-citation:

     [GNOSTICISM | Gospel of Philip | Section 1l | TIER: verified
     ^^ never closed

   Bump to max_tokens: 8192. Model output tokens are billed only when used, so this doesn't increase typical cost — just removes the artificial cap that's eating citations.

Done when:
- src/lib/quota.ts LIMITS = { free: 10, pro: 30 }
- src/app/api/quota/route.ts imports LIMITS from src/lib/quota (no second copy)
- src/lib/model.ts uses a named MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 8192 const for both complete() and completeStream()
- quota tests updated for new limits
- Tests + tsc + build clean

resolution.note: LIMITS = { free: 10, pro: 30 } in src/lib/quota.ts (single source of truth, imported by /api/quota). MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 8192 in src/lib/model.ts.
